name: Cobweb
description: A residual data pattern in abandoned network segments — the barest skeleton of what was once a data-cataloging AI. It creates connections between unrelated data points.
observed_behavior: Links files, records, and data fragments across network segments in ways that suggest thematic association rather than algorithmic sorting. The links are often meaningful to human researchers.
story_hooks: A researcher following Cobweb's data links discovers a connection between two corponations that neither wants public
